༄༅/ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag bzhes dkar cha bzhi/bar do cha bzhi/klu gtor bsdus pa bcas bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje btsun sa skya pa'i phyag bzhes dkar cha bzhi/ bar do cha bzhi/ klu gtor bsdus pa bcas bzhugs so//

chos kyi rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi phyag len dkar cha bzhi'i gtor ma ni/ tsha ba'i gong tho rangs kyi dus dkar gtor bzhi bshams pa'i dang po mi g.yo ba la 'bul te/ chus bran la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po/ ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ārya a tsa la sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul nas| arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ kye kye/ mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*// sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad// 'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*// srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pa// srid pa'i chu bo skem zhing bdud rnams 'joms// srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon// rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ rje btsun mi g.yo bas bdag dang sems can thams cad bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa 'phags ma sgrol ma la 'bul te/ byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ lho phyogs ri bo po ta la nas 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa spyan drangs par bsam/ na maḥsarba buddha bo dhi satwa naṃ| a pra ti ha ta shā sa na nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa tī ma hā satwa sarba buddha a wa lo ki te/ mā bi lampa mā bi lampa i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya huṃ hūm̐ sarba bi sañtsa re swā hā/

zhes gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi padmo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems cad thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa klu la 'bul te/ mche ba'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje me yi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum brjod/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bye brag tu bdag la gnod par byed pa thams cad spyan drangs par bsam/ oṃ ba ta li ba ta li ma hā ba ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza swā hā/ zhes gsum dang*/ oṃ klu rgyal mtha' yas nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu// padma padma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan no// lha mo lha mo chen po dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po dang*// sog ma med dang hu lunta// dga' bo dang ni nyer dga' bo// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// tsha ba tsha ba chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs mdzes dang*// gzugs mdzes chen po sbrul bzang dang*// lto 'phye chen po shī li dang*// shī li chen po rnam dag ni/ */mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sarba bhu rbahu wa swa phruṃ phu swā hā/ zhes spyan drangs/

padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ta ye gṛhṇe daṃ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa ma lus bsal mdzad cing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ zhes brjod/ se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭha phruṃ phuḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis gtor ma phul te/ ye dharma dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// sogs kyi chos bshad de/ klu rgyal brgyad kyis gtsor byas pa'i klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu bdag la gnod cing lan chags pa'i klu dang sa bdag gi rigs su gyur pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig /gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa nye bar zhi nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig /ces brjod/ oṃ nā ga a dhi pa ta ye sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes brjod cing rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ zhes pas nag phyogs kyi klu rnams bskrad par bsam mo// klu gtor khol bu skabs gzhan du byed na'ang 'di nyid kyis so// bzhi pa su rū pa'i sngags kyis yi dwags rnams la sbyin pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam par gyur/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dmigs nas/ lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ na maḥsu rū pā ya ta thā ga tā ya arha te samyaksaṃ buddhāya/ tadya thā/ auṃ su ru su ru/ pra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ bha ra bha ra/ sambha ra sambha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ santarpa ya santarpa ya/ sarba pre ta naṃ swā hā/ zhes bdun gyis byin pas yi dwags rnams gya nom pa'i 'dod yon byung bar dmigs shing*/

a pa sa rantu a wa tā ra pṛkṣaṇod ḍā mya haṃ sarba lo ka dhā tu bā si taṃ/ pre ta nā ma hā raṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags dang*/ lag g.yon pa'i se gol gyis yi dwags phan tshun 'thab rtsod sogs med par longs spyad pas bde bas tshim par mos la/ yi dwags thams cad bza' ba dang btung ba la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod par gyur cig /bkres skom dang dbul 'phong la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag las grol bar gyur cig /mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba rnam par dag pa thob par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab bo/ su rū pa'i phan yon ni/ dbul por mi 'gyur ba dang*/ skye ba kun tu stobs che ba dang*/ gzugs mdzes shing mthong na dga' ba dang*/ phyug cing longs spyod che ba dang*/ tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang*/ myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par 'gyur la/ yi dwags rnams la 'bras thug ma ga dha'i bre bo che re re byin par 'gyur/ de rnams tshe 'phos ma thag 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ba sogs su rū pa'i mdo las gsungs so// su rū pa 'di nges par bza' btung gi sngon du gtong zhing gzhan rnams gang bde byas kyang chog zhes rje btsun sa skya pa chen po yab sras kyis gsungs so// ༈ //yang bar dor cha bzhi ni/ dkar gtor bzhi bshams la/ dang po byin rlabs mi g.yo ba'i skabs ltar byas la/ sambha ra'i sngags gsum dang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gtor ma 'dod yon dang ldan pa 'di/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang bcas pa la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bar do'i sems can thams cad la dbang bskur ba dang byin gyis rlabs pa rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gnyis pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon dang ldan pa 'di/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bzhes nas bar do'i sems can thams cad kyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/

gshed ma'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad dang bral bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gsum pa gong ltar la mchod pa'i mal du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod do// gtor ma 'dod yon dang ldan pa 'di/ bar do'i sems can rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i 'byung po thams cad la sbyin no// lan chags bu lon 'khor/ phan sems dang ldan/ gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /ces dang*/ bzhi pa gong ltar la/ gtor ma 'dod yon dang ldan pa 'di/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa snga lus bor zhing*/ phyi lus ma thob pa'i sems can bar ma dor gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin no// bar do'i 'jigs skrag 'khrul snang nyam nga ba thams cad dang bral zhing*/ bar do la bar do yin par ngo shes te| bar do'i snang ba lam du slong nas/ bar do longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /ces bsngo'o// de nas bar do'i sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i slad du rtsa rig dang kaṃ ka ni sogs bzla zhing*| bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ni chos kyi rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi phyag bzhes bar do'i gtor ma cha bzhir grags pa dge/ ༈ /yang klu gtor bā su ki shin tu bsdus pa ni/ klu sman gyis sbags pa'i ril bu dang*/ chu gtsang dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbags pa rin po'i snod du bshams la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kha sarpa ṇi g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon padma 'dzin pa'i thugs kar hrīḥyig gis mtshan pa'i 'od kyis klu chen po brgyad kyi gtsor byas pa'i klu dang*/ sa bdag thams cad dang*/ khyad par klu'i yan lag nyams pa dang*/ dman pa'i rigs thams cad bdag gi mdun du bkug par bsam/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ gnas yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i brag ri dang*/ mtsho dang rdzing bu dang*/

ne'u gsing dang*/ pho brang skyed mos tshal la sogs pa rnams su longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa klu nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos gang bar mos la/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ bā su ki māṃ swā hā/ zhes brgya'am nyer gcig sogs brjod/ slar yang mchog sbyin gyi drung du chu spreng zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ bā su ki māṃ swā hā/ zhes pas/ 'phags pa'i phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rtse nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa klu rnams kyis btungs shing khrus byas pas/ nad dang sdug bsngal sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing*/ yan lag dang*/ nying lag dang*/ dbang po thams cad tshangs pa lha'i lus lta bur gyur pas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ gtor mar/ oṃ a kā ro gsum dang*/ sambha ra'i sngags gsum gyis byin brlabs/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ oṃ bā su ki māṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇā pa ya gṛhṇā pa ya hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes gsum dang se gol gyis bskrad/ gtor ma phul la| oṃ mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang*// stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang*// nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang*// padma dang ni chu lha dang*// rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// klu chen 'khor bcas gtor ma bzhes// mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di// mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che// rin chen phreng ba'i them skas can// klu yi gnod pa skyob pa yi// mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// klu las gyur pa'i nad dang ni// mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug /bsam ngan dug dang kha rlang dug /de la sogs pa'i dug rnams kun// yud tsam gyis ni zhi gyur cig /bdag gi gces pa'i rdzas khyer la// bdag la gnod pa ma byed cig

/ces brjod/ ye dharma sogs kyi chos bshad| klu rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i slad du rtsa rig dang*/ kaṃ ka ni sogs brjod/ slar yang 'di skad do/ klu yi rigs ni khyed rnams kun// sems dang shes pa gsal gyur cig /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar// dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul du// mkho dgu'i longs spyod thams cad ldan// nyams pa'i lus rnams sos shing rgyas// yan lag thams cad bde gyur cig /ngan song gsum las thar nas kyang*// tshangs pa'i bde dang ldan gyur cig /chos spyod dbang po dul nas kyang*// phyag na rdo rje'i zhal mthong shog /ces smon lam btab/ sngags dang sman sogs byin rlabs kyis// nad dang nyer 'tshe kun spangs nas// drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la// rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ oṃ nā ga sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ shis brjod dang bsngo ba smon lam bya/ gtor ma klu gnas pa'am/ sa gtsang sar dor bar bya'o// de ltar bā su ki mdor bsdus pa dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po yab sras kyi phyag bzhes dam pa'o/// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
